title: Check shortcut reference freshness at a fixed clock
requirement: Return one non-negative integer column named violation_count. This lesson models referenced-dataset evidence, not real shortcut resolution. FULL JOIN required and observed references by dataset_id/reference_id. Count missing/unexpected references, NULL observed_at, future timestamps or age strictly greater than SLA minutes; one joined row counts once. Exactly 60 minutes is fresh for a 60-minute SLA; one microsecond older is stale. Use context.as_of, never NOW(). A completed run can reference stale data, and missing capture time cannot establish freshness.
learning_objectives: Check shortcut reference freshness at a fixed clock
Separate execution, quality and incomplete evidence.
